work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper 0.1.0 – Initial release

- Introduces a practical agent workflow helper focused on Clawhub users with strong demand for Proactive Agent-style workflows.
- Supports bug fixing, reliability improvements, safety hardening, and creation of adjacent skills.
- Offers a repeatable, structured workflow for generating tailored artifacts, checklists, and decision aids.

- Includes explicit triggers and validation criteria for reliable, actionable results.
